description:
Customize the branding of the Aerobridge Django administration interface to match client requirements. 

You need to modify the Django application code (likely in the main `urls.py` configuration) to set the following `admin.site` attributes:

1. **Site Header**: Change to exactly "SkyGuard Operations"
2. **Site Title**: Change to exactly "SkyGuard Admin"
3. **Index Title**: Change to exactly "Fleet Command Center"

The application source code is located in `/opt/aerobridge`. The server is running at `http://localhost:8000`. After modifying the code, verify that the changes are visible on the admin login page and dashboard.
